description: User journey within a feature. Inherits the parent feature's envSlug at creation time so env-scoped queries can filter without joining tables.

fields.name: stack
fields.description: frontend/backend/investigating — which slice of the app this flow exercises.

fields.name: envSlug
fields.description: Owning environment slug — inherited from the parent Feature at creation time.

fields.name: clonedFromFlowId
fields.description: ItemId of the dev flow this record was cloned from. Stamped on insert by useCloneFlow. The cross-env sync feature (delete + rename) looks up sibling clones via this field — records with no value are pre-existing clones that don't participate in cascade sync.
